front: In AWS, a synchronous standby in a second Availability Zone or an asynchronous replica in a second Region: which one can lose the latest writes in a failover?
back: The asynchronous replica in the second Region.
extra: With an [asynchronously replicated datastore](../facts/global-infrastructure.md#global-infrastructure-async-cross-region-replication-may-lose-data) across Regions, there is [the possibility of data loss or inconsistency when you fail over](../facts/global-infrastructure.md#global-infrastructure-async-cross-region-replication-may-lose-data).
